sloka: पश्य लक्ष्मण संरागः तिर्यक् योनिगतेषु अपि ।यदेषा शिखिनी कामात् भर्तारम् अभिवर्तते ॥४-१-४२॥
transliteration: paśya lakṣmaṇa saṁrāgaḥ tiryak yonigateṣu api ।yadeṣā śikhinī kāmāt bhartāram abhivartate ॥4-1-42॥

translations.english: 'Had the largeeyed Janaki not been stolen, she would have also paid advances to me in this manner with all her love and excitement.
